name: Database browser
description: Browse and query an app's PostgreSQL, MariaDB, Redis and MongoDB add-ons and the SQLite databases in its files from a Data tab. Queries run read-only; a change runs only after you confirm it in a panel dialog.

capabilities.name: addons.query
capabilities.reason: Run queries against the app's database add-ons and SQLite files as the person using the Data tab, who needs permission to manage the app's environment.
